work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. The ad specifies a central Lisbon office. No other location, time-zone, or work-authorization limits are stated.
culture_signals: The company describes its values as Together, Ownership, and Pace: sharing context and helping across teams; taking responsibility, fixing problems, and learning from them; and reducing unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients.
The company describes its environment as collaborative, with teamwork and personal development prioritized; it also mentions team events and regular get-togethers.
Reviews describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues. Some reviewers say onboarding and training vary considerably between teams.
work_context.notes: The ad and company pages both state hybrid work with three days per week in the office; the ad specifies the central Lisbon office for this role. Review comments about onboarding and training are company-wide and do not establish what this role’s team provides.
